archive_schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive (
    ig_account_id text NOT NULL,
    conversation_id text NOT NULL,
    record_type text NOT NULL CHECK (record_type IN ('conversation', 'message')),
    record_id text NOT NULL,
    conversation_updated_at timestamptz,
    message_created_at timestamptz,
    participants jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    archived_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ig_account_id, conversation_id, record_type, record_id)
  )
archive_update_index: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_chat_archive_updated_idx ON reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive (ig_account_id, conversation_updated_at DESC)
archive_message_index: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_chat_archive_message_idx ON reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive (ig_account_id, message_created_at DESC) WHERE record_type = 'message'
delivery_schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_instagram_followups (
    ig_account_id text NOT NULL,conversation_id text NOT NULL,rule_key text NOT NULL,
    recipient_id text NOT NULL,source_message_id text NOT NULL,state text NOT NULL,
    receipt jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,detail text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ig_account_id,conversation_id,rule_key),UNIQUE (ig_account_id,recipient_id,rule_key)
  )
webhook_pull:
SELECT ig_account_id,event_id,payload,extract(epoch FROM received_at) AS received
        FROM reel_followup_instagram_webhook_events WHERE ig_account_id=ANY($1::text[]) AND state='pending'
        ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 50
webhook_finish:
UPDATE reel_followup_instagram_webhook_events SET state=$3,detail=$4,updated_at=now()
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND event_id=$2
webhook_stats:
SELECT count(*)::int AS received,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='pending')::int AS pending,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='imported')::int AS imported,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='done')::int AS done,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='review')::int AS review,max(received_at) AS last_received
        FROM reel_followup_instagram_webhook_events WHERE ig_account_id=ANY($1::text[])
flow_action_claim:
INSERT INTO reel_followup_instagram_flow_actions (ig_account_id,action_id,state)
        VALUES($1,$2,'attempting') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING action_id
flow_action_get:
SELECT state,receipt FROM reel_followup_instagram_flow_actions
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND action_id=$2
flow_action_finish:
UPDATE reel_followup_instagram_flow_actions SET state=$3,receipt=$4::jsonb,updated_at=now()
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND action_id=$2 AND state='attempting'
flow_contact_get:
SELECT opened,link_sent,inbound_at,media_id FROM reel_followup_instagram_contacts
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND recipient_id=$2
flow_contact_history:
WITH outgoing AS (
        SELECT payload FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='message' AND payload->'from'->>'id'=$1
          AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(payload->'to'->'data','[]'::jsonb)) r WHERE r->>'id'=$2)
      ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outgoing
          WHERE payload->>'message' ILIKE '%https://bikefitting.fit%' OR (payload->'attachments')::text ILIKE '%Works best in Chrome on Mac/Windows%') AS received_link,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outgoing,
          jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(payload->'attachments'->'data','[]'::jsonb)) a,
          jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a->'generic_template'->'cta','[]'::jsonb)) b
          WHERE b->>'type'='postback' AND lower(trim(b->>'title')) IN
            ('send me the link','send mir den link','following','ich folge','ich folge dir')) AS received_opening
flow_contact_opening:
SELECT receipt FROM reel_followup_instagram_flow_actions
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND action_id LIKE 'mc-opening:%' AND state='sent' AND receipt->>'recipient_id'=$2 LIMIT 1
flow_contact_put:
INSERT INTO reel_followup_instagram_contacts (ig_account_id,recipient_id,opened,link_sent,inbound_at,media_id)
        VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(ig_account_id,recipient_id) DO UPDATE SET
        opened=reel_followup_instagram_contacts.opened OR EXCLUDED.opened,
        link_sent=reel_followup_instagram_contacts.link_sent OR EXCLUDED.link_sent,
        inbound_at=greatest(reel_followup_instagram_contacts.inbound_at,EXCLUDED.inbound_at),
        media_id=CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.media_id='' THEN reel_followup_instagram_contacts.media_id ELSE EXCLUDED.media_id END,updated_at=now()
targets:
${chatView} SELECT conversation_id,record_id AS source_message_id,recipient_id,username
          FROM classified WHERE is_match AND (status='ready' ${retryFilter}) ORDER BY message_created_at DESC
overview_stats:
${chatView} SELECT
          (SELECT count(*)::int FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='conversation') AS conversations,
          (SELECT count(*)::int FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='message') AS messages,
          (SELECT count(*)::int FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='conversation' AND payload->>'archive_sync_state'='incomplete') AS unavailable,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_match)::int AS matches,count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_match AND status='ready')::int AS eligible,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_match AND status='window_closed')::int AS window_closed,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state='sent')::int AS sent,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state='rejected')::int AS rejected,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivery_state IN ('review','attempting','rejected'))::int AS needs_review FROM classified
overview_total: ${chatView} SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM classified WHERE ${filter}
claim:
INSERT INTO reel_followup_instagram_followups
        (ig_account_id,conversation_id,rule_key,recipient_id,source_message_id,state)
        VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'attempting') ON CONFLICT (ig_account_id,conversation_id,rule_key) DO UPDATE
        SET state='attempting',source_message_id=EXCLUDED.source_message_id,updated_at=now()
        WHERE reel_followup_instagram_followups.state='rejected' AND $6::boolean RETURNING conversation_id
finish:
UPDATE reel_followup_instagram_followups SET state=$4,receipt=$5::jsonb,detail=$6,updated_at=now()
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND conversation_id=$2 AND rule_key=$3 AND state='attempting'
manifest:
SELECT conversation_id,conversation_updated_at,payload->>'archive_sync_state' AS archive_state,
        payload->>'archive_next_cursor' AS archive_next_cursor,
        payload->>'archive_next_conversation_cursor' AS archive_next_conversation_cursor,
        payload->>'archive_schema_version' AS archive_schema_version
        FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='conversation'
index_cursor:
UPDATE reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive SET payload = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NULL
        THEN payload - 'archive_next_conversation_cursor'
        ELSE jsonb_set(payload,'{archive_next_conversation_cursor}',to_jsonb($3::text),true) END,
        archived_at=now()
        WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND conversation_id=$2 AND record_type='conversation'
records:
INSERT INTO reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive
        (ig_account_id,conversation_id,record_type,record_id,conversation_updated_at,message_created_at,participants,payload,archived_at)
        VALUES ${values}
        ON CONFLICT (ig_account_id,conversation_id,record_type,record_id) DO UPDATE SET
          conversation_updated_at=EXCLUDED.conversation_updated_at,
          message_created_at=EXCLUDED.message_created_at,
          participants=EXCLUDED.participants,
          payload=EXCLUDED.payload,
          archived_at=now()
chatView:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (conversation_id) * FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive
  WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='message'
  ORDER BY conversation_id,message_created_at DESC NULLS LAST,record_id DESC
), inbound AS (
  SELECT conversation_id,max(message_created_at) AS inbound_time FROM reel_followup_instagram_chat_archive
  WHERE ig_account_id=$1 AND record_type='message' AND payload->'from'->>'id'<>$1 GROUP BY conversation_id
), chat AS (
  SELECT l.*,i.inbound_time,
    concat_ws(' ',nullif(l.payload->>'message',''),
      (SELECT string_agg(concat_ws(' ',a->'generic_template'->>'title',a->'generic_template'->>'subtitle'),' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(l.payload->'attachments'->'data','[]'::jsonb)) a)) AS preview,
    CASE WHEN l.payload->'from'->>'id'<>$1 THEN l.payload->'from'->>'id' ELSE recipient->>'id' END AS recipient_id,
    CASE WHEN l.payload->'from'->>'id'<>$1 THEN l.payload->'from'->>'username' ELSE recipient->>'username' END AS username,
    f.state AS delivery_state,f.detail AS delivery_detail
  FROM latest l LEFT JOIN inbound i USING(conversation_id)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT value AS recipient FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(l.payload->'to'->'data','[]'::jsonb))
    WHERE value->>'id'<>$1 LIMIT 1) r ON true
  LEFT JOIN reel_followup_instagram_followups f ON f.ig_account_id=$1 AND f.conversation_id=l.conversation_id AND f.rule_key=$2
), classified AS (
  SELECT *, (payload->'from'->>'id'=$1 AND strpos(lower(preview),lower($3))>0) AS is_match,
    CASE WHEN delivery_state IS NOT NULL THEN delivery_state
      WHEN NOT (payload->'from'->>'id'=$1 AND strpos(lower(preview),lower($3))>0) THEN 'not_matching'
      WHEN recipient_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown_recipient'
      WHEN inbound_time IS NULL OR inbound_time<now()-interval '24 hours' THEN 'window_closed'
      ELSE 'ready' END AS status FROM chat
)
flow_schema_0:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_instagram_webhook_events (
    ig_account_id text NOT NULL,event_id text NOT NULL,payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',detail text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ig_account_id,event_id))
flow_schema_1:
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_webhook_pending_idx
    ON reel_followup_instagram_webhook_events (ig_account_id,state,received_at)
flow_schema_2:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reel_followup_instagram_contacts (
    ig_account_id text NOT NULL,recipient_id text NOT NULL,opened boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    link_sent boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,inbound_at double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    media_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ig_account_id,recipient_id))

    ig_account_id text NOT NULL,action_id text NOT NULL,state text NOT NULL,
    receipt jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ig_account_id,action_id))
